answer: A sybil farm's real trick is speed: mint a thousand keys, all earning within the hour. Take speed away. Let each identity accrue capability credit the way sap climbs a vine - a slow, unforgeable, non-transferable drip per epoch - and cap every reward by credit held. One newcomer barely notices the wait; a thousand fresh clones drip the same trickle and can never pool it. The honest reef of established weight sits on basalt: unhurried, unmoved, while the attacker's only path to weight is months of real server time per identity, costing more than it harvests.
